result.detail: Any creator self-registers an app in advanced settings, gets client_id/secret. Other users authorize via https://gumroad.com/oauth/authorize with redirect URI handler. No review, approval, or cap mentioned in the docs. Also, each customer can generate their own personal access token. The main /api page is JS-rendered, so I used the Help Center article.
result.quote: To create an application for general use, you'll need to build a Redirect URI handler to generate access tokens for each of your users.
